title.narrative: Design support REGSRHR Public Health Agency of Sweden

description.narrative: Folkhälsomyndigheten får stöd av Sida att utarbeta ett programförslag baserat på konceptpappret 2023-04-05 ”Ett svenskt initiativ för ett innovativt kapacitetsutvecklingsprogram för att stärka sexuell och reproduktiv hälsa och rättigheter i folkhälsoinstitutioner i Botswana, Moçambique, Zambia och Zimbabwe”.

The Public Health Agency of Sweden receives support from Sida to formulate a project proposal based on the 5 April 2023 concept paper “A Swedish initiative for an innovative capacity development program for strengthening of Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights in public health institutions in Botswana, Mozambique, Zambia and Zimbabwe.”

Insatsens mål är att formulera ett förslag till regionalt SRHRprogram i Afrika baserat på Fohm:s konceptpappret 20230405 A Swedish initiative for an innovative capacity development program for strengthening of Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights in public health institutions in Botswana, Mozambique, Zambia and Zimbabwe. Det resulterande programdokumentet ska bl a *vara konsistent med målen för Sveriges Strategi för sexuell och reproduktiv hälsa och rättigheter (SRHR) i Afrika 20222026 och med viktiga regionala SRHRstrategier och initiativ. *vara förankrad hos de tilltänkta partners i regionen och ha deras helhjärtade stöd. *vara genomförbart och effektivt med rimliga, väl hanterade risker.

The contribution's total budget was 1 MSEK to be used to design, formulate and submit a draft proposal for a project with a tentative budget of 39 MSEK. A first draft proposal was submitted by the Public Health Agency of Sweden (PHAS, in Swedish Folkhälsomyndigheten, FOHM) to Sida in February 2024. Sida gave its written and oral feedback to PHAS and later received a revised proposal. However, the final proposal was awaiting much complementary information based on the outcomes from a planned workshop. In May 2024, the workshop took place with the four participating countries: Botswana, Mozambique, Rwanda and Zimbabwe. The workshop was hosted by Africa CDC who will play a regional role in the full programme.
PHAS developed a full proposal for support which was submitted to Sida at the Embassy of Pretoria on 20 June 2024, including a plan and budget for year 1.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
